quick_verdict.roast: I am deeply disappointed to find that this establishment, boasting a 1490-word README and 29763 stars, has served absolutely no fresh courses during the hackathon window, with 0 commits inside the period and the last push dated 2026-10-06. It is akin to a restaurant that has perfected its menu description but has not actually cooked a single dish for the current service.

fixes.fix: Add a YouTube, Loom, or Vimeo link to a demo video in the README that is 3 minutes or shorter and showcases all three tools.
Include a before/after comparison in the README, with concrete numbers illustrating performance gains.
Document a run where an action failed and describe how the agent recovered, adding this narrative to the README.
Make at least one commit dated within the hackathon window to demonstrate active development during the event.
Add neatlogs to the dependencies and show its usage in the code, then provide trace links in the README.
Include screenshots or URLs of neatlogs trace logs in the README to satisfy the trace link requirement.

quick_verdict.best_thing: The README accurately claims that smolagents supports any LLM, as verified by examples/agent_from_any_llm.py.
